items.title: Anthropic's watermark rollout leaves a loophole on two older Claude models
items.summary: Anthropic is watermarking four more Claude models ahead of the EU AI Act deadline, but on Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 changing sampling settings strips the mark.
items.imageAlt: Illustration of a magnifying glass held over faint watermarked text beside the Anthropic starburst logo

items.title: SpaceX loses bid to toss NAACP lawsuit over Memphis data center air pollution
items.summary: A federal judge refused to dismiss the NAACP's Clean Air Act suit, rejecting SpaceXAI's claim that its 27 gas turbines near Memphis were exempt from permits.
items.imageAlt: Aerial view of the SpaceXAI data center and gas turbine power plant site under construction outside Memphis

items.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
items.summary: Sean Hollister turned a $50 Waveshare ESP32 pendant into a Muse-compatible AI pet using Claude Code, adding avatars and a Tamagotchi game before Meta ships Muse Charm.
items.imageAlt: A gold-rimmed pendant with a round touchscreen showing a pixel-art pet, battery level and on-screen buttons

items.title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
items.summary: Ollie, an SOC 2-certified AI assistant backed by Khosla Ventures, told users it is shutting down on 6 November after failing to compete with better-funded rivals.
items.imageAlt: Ollie's promo image: the wordmark with the line 'Your personal AI assistant for everyday life' over a photo of a family

items.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
items.summary: Apple will ship Apple Intelligence in China: an iOS 27.3 beta on 4 November and a full release in December, with Alibaba's Qwen chatbot integrated but no new Siri AI.
items.imageAlt: An iPhone on a wooden floor showing its home screen with weather widgets and a soft Apple Intelligence glow along the bottom edge

items.title: Zest's new AI agent finds restaurants and books reservations over text
items.summary: Zest launched an AI concierge that collects a group's tastes over text, puts restaurant options to a vote and books the table for everyone.
items.imageAlt: Screenshot of Zest's chat interface showing a text thread that suggests a French restaurant and returns a booking confirmation

items.title: Google's first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
items.summary: Google's Project Suncatcher prototype, carrying four TPUs and running DeepMind's Gemma 4, sent its first AI response from orbit and now faces radiation tests.
items.imageAlt: A Planet Labs satellite with folded solar panels on a mount in a clean room before launch

items.title: DoorDash said it's only received 'several hundred' orders from AI agents
items.summary: DoorDash said AI agents have placed only several hundred orders so far, and that it is open to working with third-party agent makers on integration.
